File paths: src/auth/login.ts:42 handles password verification. src/auth/jwt.ts:15 implements token signing. The authentication flow starts when a user submits credentials through the login form.

Turn 2: JWT token implementation details. JWT encodes user claims signs with secret key distributes to clients. Three parts: header payload signature separated by dots. Header specifies algorithm payload contains claims signature computed using header and payload. Key file: src/auth/jwt.ts:78 contains the verifyToken function. Token expiration and refresh logic at src/auth/jwt.ts:120.

Turn 3: Security considerations include brute force protection rate limiting session fixation prevention token storage in httpOnly cookies proper token expiration CSRF protection and HTTPS enforcement. Turn 4: Database layer for authentication. User credentials stored in users table with bcrypt-hashed passwords. Session tokens in sessions table with expiry timestamps. Migration file: src/db/migrations/001_users.sql. Model: src/db/models/user.ts:25 defines the User schema. Query helpers at src/db/queries/auth.ts:40.

Turn 5: API endpoints for auth. POST /api/auth/login accepts credentials returns JWT. POST /api/auth/refresh exchanges refresh token. POST /api/auth/logout invalidates session. GET /api/auth/me returns current user. Routes defined in src/routes/auth.ts:10. Validation middleware at src/middleware/validate.ts:20.

## Authentication System Discussion

Discussed authentication system across 5 topics:

### Auth Methods & JWT
Passwords, biometrics, 2FA, JWT. JWT: header+payload+signature, verifyToken at src/auth/jwt.ts:78, token signing at src/auth/jwt.ts:15, refresh at src/auth/jwt.ts:120.

### Security
Rate limiting at src/middleware/auth.ts:30, CSRF at src/middleware/csrf.ts:15, httpOnly cookies, SQL injection prevention.

### Database
Users table (bcrypt passwords), sessions table (expiry). Migration: src/db/migrations/001_users.sql. Model: src/db/models/user.ts:25. Queries: src/db/queries/auth.ts:40.

### API Endpoints
POST /login, /refresh, /logout. GET /me. Routes: src/routes/auth.ts:10. Validation: src/middleware/validate.ts:20.

### Decisions
Chose JWT over session tokens for scalability. Rate limiting at middleware layer.
